content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

Automated ebook delivery after crypto payment is the architecture that empowers digital creators to sell their products directly to customers without relying on conventional payment processors. By leveraging a combination of cloud hosting, backend logic, and cryptocurrency payment solutions, creators can receive payments in various digital currencies. This model not only eliminates high platform fees—Gumroad, for example, charges 10% on every sale, while NOWPayments only takes 0.5%—but also grants creators complete ownership of their sales and customer data, fostering a sustainable business model.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The backbone of this automated system consists of several interconnected components. Creators can host their digital products on platforms like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, utilizing Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic. When a customer makes a payment using NOWPayments, the crypto transaction is confirmed, triggering an automated delivery process. This means ebooks are delivered instantly upon payment, streamlining the customer experience and ensuring creators can focus on producing content rather than managing logistics.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions where traditional payment platforms are not accessible. Whether you are selling ebooks, online courses, or digital templates, this setup provides a reliable and efficient way to monetize your products. By embracing this technology, creators can break free from the limitations imposed by conventional platforms and build a direct relationship with their customers, leading to increased sales and greater financial independence.
Automated delivery ensures customers receive products instantly after payment.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Key components include a hosting service like GitHub Pages for storing digital products, backend solutions such as Cloudflare Workers for automating processes, and NOWPayments for facilitating cryptocurrency transactions. Each component plays a vital role in ensuring the system operates smoothly, allowing creators to focus on their craft while enjoying the benefits of a fully automated sales process. This comprehensive architecture not only enhances operational efficiency but also empowers creators with data ownership and control over their sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, creators should first choose a hosting platform such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to store their digital products. Next, they will need to set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to automate order processing. After integrating NOWPayments for cryptocurrency transactions, creators can load their products and initiate the automated delivery process. By following these steps, creators can deploy their own automated ebook delivery system without relying on traditional payment processors.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, creators can utilize a sovereign commerce infrastructure that automates payment processing and product delivery through cryptocurrency. By leveraging tools like NOWPayments, Cloudflare, and Google Apps Script, creators can ensure efficient transactions and customer satisfaction while maintaining full ownership of their products. This architecture circumvents the limitations imposed by conventional platforms.
NOWPayments reduces transaction fees to just 0.5%, maximizing your profits.

For those looking to navigate the complexities of selling digital products without traditional payment processors, exploring The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) offers valuable insights and step-by-step guidance. This resource details the infrastructure needed to set up automated delivery systems and can be found at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.

Yes, you can sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip by setting up your own automated delivery system. Utilizing a combination of cloud hosting, backend logic, and cryptocurrency payment processing enables you to sell directly to customers.

Using cryptocurrency for digital product sales offers lower transaction fees, faster payment confirmation, and greater privacy. This approach also eliminates the need for traditional payment processors, granting you full control over your sales and customer data.
